articles.title: Cloudflare introduces wallets for AI agents, plans stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: Cloudflare introduced programmable Wallets for AI agents and said payment features using stablecoins will launch in a future update.

articles.title: XRP Holders Can Now Borrow Ripple's RLUSD on Ethereum Without Selling Their Crypto
articles.snippet: Flare's FXRP has been approved as collateral in a $280 million RLUSD lending vault, allowing XRP holders to tap Ethereum's lending markets.
